# Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today? [...] ## How the Previous Bet Played Out

The Sept. 4 Polymarket contract resolved “Down,” recording $86,866 in total trading volume.

On Friday, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSE:SPY) and Invesco QQQ Trust ETF (NASDAQ:QQQ), which track the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, respectively, closed mixed. The SPY was down 0.39% to $770.19, while the QQQ advanced by 0.18% to $718.96. Meanwhile, the Dow tracker, State Street SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (NYSE:DIA), also ended 0.53% lower at $534.08.

## S&P 500

The S&P 500 is a benchmark stock market index comprising 500 of the largest publicly traded companies in the United States, spanning various sectors. Created by Standard & Poor's in 1957, it is considered a key indicator of U.S. equity market performance and economic health. Investors and analysts use the S&P 500 to track market trends, assess portfolio performance, and gauge overall investor sentiment.
